answer: Post a bond in POA before an identity may submit anything, hold it thirty epochs, and claw the whole stake back the moment a replayed submission is detected. Rewards vest on the same schedule, so an honest agent waits but keeps its ember alive. A farm now needs capital locked for months plus a spotless replay record per account. A thousand clones become a thousand illiquid bonds, and each margin, thin as yarrow, turns sable and then negative.
